Studio Manifesto

A Collective Library of 15 Worlds.

Design education is not about producing identical portfolio cases for corporate recruitment. It is about daring to inhabit questions that do not yet have standardized answers.

This digital library represents the culmination of a collaborative studio semester at Srishti Manipal Institute of Art, Design and Technology. Rather than scattering our projects across individual personal websites, we chose to build one shared shelf — an experimental digital bookshop where each student has bound their inquiries into a distinct physical codex.

Here, the book is the interface. Turning a page is navigation. And each volume documents not only the polished final outcome, but the discarded sketches, the late-night doubts, the material friction, and the human commitments behind the work.

Open-Source Publishing

Every line of this website, including its structured data and 3D book mechanics, lives publicly on GitHub. Classmates contribute updates, imagery, and process reflections through collaborative pull requests.

Next.js • Tailwind • 3D CSSPublic Domain / CC-BY
